notes.title: An Important Update on Devilated and Trunka's Health
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,  


This is Iain from Neon Doctrine, and I am writing to share sad information with the Devilated and Neon Doctrine communities: the lead developer of Devilated, Trunka, is currently experiencing a very serious health issue, and is unable to work on the game and will not be able to continue development or interact for the foreseeable future. 
 
We will not be going into any additional details and ask that the community respect the wishes of Trunka and his family for privacy during this time, but please know that everyone is working to support him during this time. 

What does this mean for Devilated? It means that we will be moving forward with the launch as agreed by Trunka and Neon Doctrine leadership prior to his health issues. The original contracts and profit shares will remain in place. We have also spoken with his family and they have given their blessing for us to launch. Thanks to the assistance of Trunka and his family, Neon Doctrine is able to provide development support to Devilated but we are currently unable to do any content updates and will focus polishing and fixing any issues that arise after launch. It will also likely take us longer to fix issues than is normal as our teams are unfamiliar with Devilated’s code. Devilated has gone through the Neon Doctrine QA process, and we are very happy with the content and quality of Devilated but it’s important that players understand the situation so that their purchases can be made with full knowledge.  

As Trunka’s partners on Devilated, we believe his health and safety comes first, we are continuing to reach out to Trunka’s family to offer our support and any assistance we can give. He has been an incredible developer to work with, and launching Devilated without him is truly heartbreaking, but ultimately we and his family feel that it is the right thing to do. 

We will, of course, keep you updated should anything change regarding this news, hopefully with tidings of his return to full health. 

Sincerely, 

Iain Garner 
CEO  
Neon Doctrine

Hi folks,

Trunka here, I'm releasing Devilated V0.9.5 during this Steam FPS Fest. It is quite a big update from the last 0.9 version, and let's enjoy the newest changes I made to the game.

notes.title: Update V0.8.14 & The MIX Next 2021
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/aea6bf1c46d47a1f0219c62a769a710aa753e509.jpg
Hi folks,
Devilated is joining The MIX (The Media Indie Exchange) this time! Here is the new trailer:

[previewyoutube=L_CD1igzzRg;full][/previewyoutube]

After discussing, we have decided to reduce the price of Devilated to $20 and bring joy to a wider audience.

And to make up for this change, the soundtrack from Sigurd Jøhnk-Jensen ($7 including mp3, lossless and some extras) is given to everyone who purchased the game before this update.

These changes affect the overall gameplay from the start, especially the weapon balancing. 
The inventory could need some reorganization as the slot count is increased.
If your saved game is affected by the new flow much, you can always revert to the older V0.8.13 version. Try keeping at it for a while first.


Back to 6 specific weapon slots
now the player has to choose a good weapon for each type instead of putting all samey machine guns in every slot - while still being able to equip 2 handguns early on. This is like going back to the root with a hybrid solution to the 'Can't equip both the revolver and another handgun at the same time' and the 'Free slots make weapons feel repetitive' problems.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/7fcad7335934c87c0ba7ffc6ea07c7f2260306ce.jpg
Auto switch to another weapon when the current weapon is out of ammo/ durability
Right click a weapon in the inventory to use Quick Equip (even if that weapon slot is occupied)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/b3d32d0429cd80edb3f46e75456c13e77fdba7c8.jpg
The melee weapon can be charged now (R button)

	+ Charging makes you invulnerable, increases the damage up to 4x, increases the movement speed but it drains the weapon's durability. 

	+ Overcharging results in nearby enemies stunned & pushed away but it resets the charging bar & leaves you vulnerable to attacks for a bit.

	+ Every attack with a melee weapon pushes enemies away.

	+ Wielding a melee weapon charges less dashing energy (6 times dashing instead of 3)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/f94e30f3b4b8a66266d6b667e1207eaf86e4065a.gif

The ammo capacity for machine guns/ heavy guns are reduced. Combined with auto-switching, this makes you use every weapon available flawlessly.
Inventory slot count is increased to 64 instead of 49
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/63845a584798b797a72b14f83326616c8822d5c7.jpg
The ammo/durability upgrade is removed, the HP upgrade count is increased.
These are now designed to use every weapon in your equipment (flowing with auto-switching) until most of them are out of durability (which could be quickly replaced with other weapons in a bigger inventory by using the Quick-Equip button) 

A proper Tutorial section is added at the start
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/8e757fe095656b6026d7aee7ab8537a0b723b799.gif
Enemies & Bosses hit feedback is tweaked.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/c29edf8422b86e3782d35f443693a33deffc0f35.gif
Blessing Statue recovers all weapons' 100% durability & ammo, and defeating a boss also does the same thing now.
Enemy spawning in NG+ modes is reverted to the normal one with a high enemy count & not randomized anymore. (it shows progression and is more fun. but a wreck for your machine)
The weapon repairing price is changed based on the current level now (cheaper at start)
Brighter UI with RE4/5 health indicator style. All the gauges around the crosshair are removed - now Bullet-time/ Dashing/ Reloading bars are separated and only shown at an appropriate time.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/b69037f12f586bf6864f65e5940be3adec966229.jpg
Some enemies' damage is reduced, including most of the high-damage shooters, fishes, 1-hit kill molten-sword dude, and toxic spitter dude. (I call them Horn and Mutant Dwarf)
Diving adds more Stylish points
Dog in town doing nothing. You can choke it (can be called petting but whatever)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/9ce7939ab955e3e21a5576ae0036461c73e861ae.jpg
Enemy hit color shows the correct one (orange with HP resource enemy, blue with Ammo resource enemy) instead of having all blue.
Some enemies & all the bosses have Emissive parts on them now.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/0ee324d7e92d64e5775e613ce67d53fcbcbaee70.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/1490a93cb59e9a8cc2bba236b85d7f711565ea4b.gif
The Death Screen is simplified: A panel is automatically shown when you are dead with related options. You can simply press E without doing anything else to reload the last saved file after death.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/8ab7b6c3921861538993265bfd515e718da74004.png
Saving Timestamp is added, with the latest saved file marked.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/23361cbcc494754bf21a6dc03ea0d649faec0a3c.png
Loading a saved game makes you invulnerable to attacks for a few seconds.
Increasing the Stylish bar will increase the attack speed now. Be offended.
Incoming arrows are changed: besides small arrows indicating nearby enemies (useful to detect the melee ones), there are mid-sized arrows (normal attacks) and big arrows (high-damage attacks).
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/a35de850d561b8436414ef0bb38c373eb532fdfe.jpg
Enemy pre-attack is tweaked
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/aaf72e22d0c71a9a4227cecdc6265ec43ea604f0.gif
Shooters rotate towards the player more slowly.
Limbo cursor item is completely back. Looks weird, but well, it works.
Picking up gibs is removed to avoid accidentally doing that while using Diving.
Player colliding radius is smaller.
Secrets (except for the text easter eggs) all contain grenade items.
All the heavy guns are non-burst type now.
You can wipe off the crab/ trap by repeatedly pressing F now.
The loading screen is tweaked.
 Rocket launchers/ Cannons are tweaked to be stronger.
 Heavy enemy attacks are more clear in visual and audio.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/22c18a9919c35b6803eab4b9d9bc63d28651435f.jpg

Thanks to Neon Doctrine QA team - Froggy & Dylan Wei

and the community: Dotoo, Mr. NoName, GMStarson, Matheo, Kuro, CrudD and everyone 

Especially Walkinon_bodies for the long Twitch streaming sessions with not-frequently-seen real-time reactions.

Cheers,
Trunks

notes.title: Neon Doctrine cooperation, The Indie House, and Update V0.8.12
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/9a54f8bd7561ff64af2adc6947f4071d9905dd98.png

Hey folks, Trunks here. The publisher is Neon Doctrine, they have an amazing list of games you can check out, and they are very nice guys. Neon Doctrine is bringing Devilated to The Indie House event this year. 
[previewyoutube=Hrfw2XlMNzw;full][/previewyoutube]

And the full reveal event:
[previewyoutube=bi25oCVIE7M;full][/previewyoutube]

Below are the changes since the last May update. If you bought in the Realms Deep event, chances are you've seen parts of them as I've been pushing them out gradually. If you are with the old builds and haven't finished, it's recommended to restart as the design is changed (password "LowkeyVibeMode" for older versions).

Push-forward combat 
with in-battle colored resources. Potion system, potion shop and gem shop are removed. Ammo is reduced, forcing switching weapons constantly. Orange corpse heals 30 HP, blue corpse heals 50% all weapons' ammo, white corpse gives 1 grenade. Thanks to Demetroid for the suggestion of incorporating the push-forward design more closely in Devilated. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/ca120c7b16a61714055d8f29fa310a4129c3ffe2.gif

'Durability' is added
Previously, 'weapon disappearing' forced constant weapon switching. Now broken weapons could be kept in the inventory to be recharged at Bless Point (once per level). Merchant now recharges durability instead of providing ammo (costly)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/c4283c2d513751f4fc8c862d70a2f9185c7178cf.gif

Picking a corpse up by standing near it
instead of having to point at it. Combine Diving with Use key.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/19750cad3c0ae2c90fba1bb8bc05ca463a25da23.gif

Main loop
+ Low on HP/Ammo: Explode corpse/ Use Diving
		+ Low on Durability: Keep in the inventory to recharge at Bless Point/ Replace with new weapons (from merchant/ crates)
		+ Out of ammo: Switch to other weapons to passively regain that weapon's ammo via blue enemies/ Replace with new weapons

Compass with next point marker Hard to get lost now.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/06bbddf965c38f9839acc797205e2585951ff828.gif

Kill text is added 
Each kill has an absurd text flying up with a color indicating the hp/ammo/grenade resource. The default brightness is increased and the contrast is lowered. Easier to see enemies killed even in the dark now.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/29d7bbaee3b2c534eff84a2525f3a8ae84a7f3fe.gif

Enemies are more stupid
(run horizontally sometimes instead of only charging at player)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/40438b13c4889cb35f8ac1269b716c3bfb2f8256.gif

Bosses' vulnerable parts are highlighted with outlines.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/d7b08442ddd5941fb104e338bb70b3b67793b3b2.gif

Consumable orange & blue fires in Boss fights for hp & ammo that can regenerate later.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/945a734ccb09e1035cd7556908a9c2955b6ce715.gif

Unlock more variations of weapons, enemies,... earlier in the game
The start of the game becomes difficult sooner.

Bullet-time is limited
just enough to fight in later levels. Incoming Enemy Arrows/ HP/ Ammo/ Dash/ BulletTime bars added around the crosshair: Easily monitored instead of looking at the screen corners.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/eaff09497af852765254948b0cd79d2d3a3dd5c5.gif

Defeating boss rewards Spawning 4 random items & Recharging 100% HP + Durability + Ammo for all weapons.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/79e590416d10b87e8e3986104a15fe84d27b016c.gif

Enemies in Slaughter II and Slaughter III (NG+) are randomized
After completing the game in Slaughter I, the final enemy variation is maintained onto the next NG+ with unpredictability & increased enemy number instead of first levels' grunt enemies again.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/d8c9bae2652e47b32114023c466454943b1f7fca.gif

Show damage stats and labels
(explosive/ energetic...) on weapons except for Staffs. Except for the Machine guns which are more consistent, damage is a rough estimation as weapons are varied.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/8715219aef48746be749199ac1a7861d5a6bdff0.jpg

"Retro" as the default color
instead of "Raw". The game is more cohesive in style.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/8273caa05e092dc4543b1d19def8f7de070e5108.jpg

Default Warrior difficulty is harder
(+50%). 5 difficulty levels instead of 10.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/c9c7d8dacc6edec87d7b9f3cc2fc2a4fcc6923c7.png

- Meat shield: more effective (blocking 65%) at the cost of its durability
- Maximum gold = 20k.
- Stylish bar is now a speed multiplier
- Encampment portals are scattered around the map. Some buttons are removed
- Fewer total equipment slots & inventory slots
- Movement is smoother & less restricted.
- The game is slowed down a bit
- Teleporting point is hidden in the Encampment area until the very last level.
- Added a setting to not increase music volume during combat
- Focus mode: Zooming in amount reduced, mouse looking sensitivity reduced.
- Loading screen is simplified.
- Full changelog: https://steamcommunity.com/app/570950/discussions/0/3110267314130087922/

Working with Neon Doctrine, from now on I'll keep the most updated experimental version at "FutureMan" branch

And as I've usually said, it is always easiest to manage the expectations :) 

Thanks to Ty - In The Keep, Demetroid, Matheo, Adria Carrasco, Nikolay Korneev, Choo Choo, Dotoo and Shang-Pao for the feedback.

Cheers!
